parameter_extension: Remove only fixed Q and fixed R_max from that fixture as explicitly authorized by OMC-010, OMC-012 and the OMC-015 goal. Every other parameter retains its exact source value.

domain.carrier: Exact OMC-004 G_n for every integer n>=2; anchored open strip with its unsplit frontier square.
domain.vertex_coordinates: At EVERY vertex: aperture bit j_v, radial bit ell_v, phase bit k_v in {0,1}; s_v=epsilon+(1-epsilon)j_v and psi_v=R ell_v (-1)^k_v.
domain.edge_coordinates: One link bit u_e per oriented representative edge, U_e=(-1)^u_e; inverse edges are determined, not independent.
domain.multiplicity: Phase labels at ell_v=0 remain distinct coordinates, as in the OMC-012 neutral projection and component root domain. No gauge quotient is taken. Q is sum ell and is only a deterministic grade tag. There is no tagged probe in this cylinder/dynamics task.
domain.measure: Counting measure on the entire component-disjoint union; exactly the inherited counting measure in each Q.
domain.norm: The squared finite Gibbs L2 norm mu_(n,R)(|f|^2); this is the new ensemble norm, with component conditional laws unchanged.
domain.generator: Unchanged blockwise PAH-001 L on all finite functions. Retain phase/link + and - channels separately at K=2. Radial transfers obey binary occupation constraints. Aperture roots obey the two-point aperture grid. Each allowed root has its declared inverse and positive symmetric mobility.
domain.projection: Existing finite gauge/anchor Reynolds projection, with the OMC-012 coordinate restriction and OMC-013 pointwise common-cylinder generator. No projection-based charge redistribution or new physical projection.
domain.time_boundary: Finite stationary initial-value Markov law, external stochastic time t>=0, no terminal conditioning. No quantum KMS assertion.

ensemble.allowed_dependencies: Only the fixed source functional, exact state domain, n and R through the displayed partition sums. beta and all other parameters are frozen.
forbidden: additional Q or R or volume dependent rescue weight

observables.target: All four iterated limits lim_n lim_R mu_(n,R)(|f|^2) exist and are strictly positive.

limits.inner: R_max=R->infinity over positive integers at every fixed n>=2, with K=2,M_s=M_psi=1,epsilon=1/2,beta=nu=1,m2=0 and other fixture parameters unchanged.
limits.outer: n->infinity only after the inner limit.
limits.scope: Restricted OMC-010 path only, not full joint local-cutoff removal, not physical lattice refinement.
